**Project-level:**
- Added `<IsAotCompatible>true</IsAotCompatible>` to the csproj

**Reflection-based code (annotated with `[RequiresUnreferencedCode]`/`[RequiresDynamicCode]`):**
- `ArmOperation.Rehydrate<T>()`, `RehydrateAsync<T>()`, and `IsResource<T>()`
- `GenericOperationSource<T>.CreateResult()`

**`JsonSerializer.Serialize(this)` → manual Utf8JsonWriter:**
- `ArmEnvironment.ToString()`

**`JsonSerializer.Deserialize<Dictionary<...>>` → `JsonDocument` parsing:**
- `ArmClientOptions.SetApiVersionsFromProfile()`

**`ModelReaderWriter.Read` without context → with context:**
- `GenericOperationSource.CreateResult()` — added `AzureResourceManagerContext.Default`

**`JsonSerializer.Serialize(writer, X)` → `writer.WriteObjectValue(X, options)` (10 files):**
- `ArmPlan`, `ManagedServiceIdentity`, `ExtendedLocation`, `ResponseError`, `SubResource`

**`JsonSerializer.Deserialize<T>(rawText)` → direct `Deserialize*` methods (27 calls):**
- `SystemData` (14 files), `ManagedServiceIdentity`, `ArmPlan`, `ExtendedLocation`, `UserAssignedIdentity`, `OperationStatusResult`, `SubResource`, `ManagedServiceIdentityType`

**`ResponseError` deserialize → `ModelReaderWriter.Read<ResponseError>` with context:**
- `OperationStatusResult.Serialization.cs`, `ResourceGroupExportResult.Serialization.cs`

**`ManagedServiceIdentity.Serialization.cs` — removed `jOptions` dependency:**
- Replaced `JsonSerializer.Serialize(writer, ManagedServiceIdentityType, jOptions)` with direct `writer.WritePropertyName`/`WriteStringValue`
- Replaced `JsonSerializer.Deserialize<ManagedServiceIdentityType>` with direct `new ManagedServiceIdentityType(property.Value.GetString())`
- Updated converter to no longer pass `JsonSerializerOptions` through
